notes.title: INDIKA Photo Mode Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1] 🖤 INDIKA Photo Mode - Capture the Madness and Win! 💛 [/h1]

Greetings, INDIKA enthusiasts and aspiring surrealist photographers!

We're thrilled to announce that [b]INDIKA is getting even more bizarre and captivating with our brand new Photo Mode[/b]! Now you can capture all those wonderfully weird moments in stunning detail – and potentially win some exclusive prizes!

[previewyoutube=POGKOVVLz9s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]📸 What's in store for you?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Freeze time and space to set up the perfect shot
[*] Adjust camera angles to showcase INDIKA's surreal landscapes
[*] Play with filters to enhance the game's already mind-bending visuals
[*] Add stickers and frames to truly make your screenshots pop (or terrify)
[*] Share your creations directly to social media and make your friends question your sanity
[/list]

Whether you're posing with peculiar characters, documenting unexplainable phenomena, or just admiring the twisted beauty of INDIKA's world, Photo Mode is your ticket to preserving those "Did that really just happen?" moments.

[h2]🎮 How to access Photo Mode[/h2]
Simply press {INSERT_KEYBIND_HERE} during gameplay to enter Photo Mode. It's that easy! Just remember, the game world stops when you're in Photo Mode, but your mind might keep racing.

[quote]"We wanted to give players a way to capture the essence of INDIKA's uniqueness. With Photo Mode, you're not just playing the game – you're curating your own gallery of the absurd." - 11 bit studios team[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/839f709f54c5e0a7024e11fdb99e9945d1698bd6.jpg[/img]

To celebrate the launch of Photo Mode, we're excited to announce the INDIKA Photo Contest!

[h3]🏆 How to Participate:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Take your most creative, bizarre, or beautiful screenshots using INDIKA's new Photo Mode
[*] Share your masterpiece on Twitter/X, Facebook, or Instagram
[*] Tag your post with #INDIKAPhotoMode
[/list]

October 21, 2024 - October 28, 2024 (23:59 CET)

[h3]🎁 Prizes:[/h3]
Three lucky winners will receive an exclusive INDIKA-themed t-shirt!

[list]

[*] By entering, you grant us the right to use your screenshot for marketing purposes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/36044f584224050a9f9c2645fc1dc617ff9aded2.jpg[/img]

[*] Full contest [url=https://www.11bitstudios.com/docs/INDIKA%20Photomode%20contest.pdf]rules can be found here[/url].

Stay weird, stay wonderful, and happy photographing!

notes.title: INDIKA Original Soundtrack
notes.content:
[h1] 🖤 INDIKA's Haunting Soundtrack Now Available! 💛 [/h1]

Greetings, lost souls and wayward nuns!

The [b]INDIKA Original Soundtrack[/b] has escaped its divine (or perhaps, devilish?) confinement and is now available everywhere! Composed by [b]Mike Sabadash[/b], this auditory journey will take you back to our alternate Russia at the turn of the XIX century, where the line between holy and unholy blurs like a feverish dream.

[url=https://soundtracks.lnk.to/indika][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/1961eabb32aba9c4d9e5888fa3d35595ac470f3a.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]What (un)holy melodies await?[/h2]

[list]
[*] 24 tracks of mind-bending, soul-stirring music
[*] A perfect blend of eerie atmospherics and classic 8-bit chiptune elements
[*] Each track named after a book of the Bible’s Old Testament (because why not mix the sacred with the profane?)
[*] From "Genesis" to "Apocalypse," with some surprising stops in between
[/list]

Whether you're questioning your faith, chatting with the devil, or just enjoying a leisurely stroll through surreal landscapes, this soundtrack is your perfect companion.

[h2]Where to find this auditory temptation?[/h2]

The [url=https://soundtracks.lnk.to/indika]INDIKA OST[/url] is available on all major music platforms. Go forth and listen, but remember – headphones are recommended. We can't be held responsible for any existential crises that may occur in public spaces.

[quote]"We wanted to create a soundtrack that makes you question your sanity, just like our dear Indika. Mission accomplished?" - Mike Sabadash, probably…[/quote]

[h2]A match made in... somewhere[/h2]
This heavenly (or hellish) collaboration between 11 bit studios and Milan Records marks our second foray into the world of surreal soundscapes. First - the Frostpunk 2, now INDIKA – we're on a roll!

[url=https://soundtracks.lnk.to/indika][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/d8055ae8498faca5ed5b09c4a23fdbf5e659fe81.jpg[/img][/url]

So, what are you waiting for? Dive into the INDIKA OST and let your ears experience the same delightful confusion as your eyes did in the game!

Stay odd, stay questioning, and happy listening!

Your ever-enigmatic friends at 11 bit studios

[h3]P.S.[/h3] 
If you start hearing voices after listening to the soundtrack, don't worry. That's probably just Mike Sabadash whispering the secrets of the universe directly into your brain. Totally normal.

notes.title: Best Indie Game at Golden Joystick Awards Nomination
notes.content:
Adventurers who embraced INDIKA's monastic life!

We have some thrilling news to share with you all today.

[h2]Best Indie Game Nomination: INDIKA[/h2]

We're immensely proud and humbled to announce that 🖤 [b]INDIKA [/b]has been nominated for "[b]Best Indie Game[/b]" in the [b]42nd Golden Joystick Awards[/b]! 🖤 This nomination is a celebration of your willingness to engage with its challenging themes and unique gameplay mechanics. Your journey through faith and doubt has allowed us to push the boundaries of storytelling in games.

[url=http://goldenjoysticks.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/6220dce8a871f1f088ae62304a43752a8ff70b38.jpg[/img][/url]

This recognition affirms the power of indie games to create meaningful, thought-provoking experiences. It's a testament to the connection we've built with you - our players, who have embraced [b]INDIKA[/b]'s distinctive narrative and gameplay.

[h3]11 bit studios: Studio of the Year Nomination[/h3]

[url=http://goldenjoysticks.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/0e7d58e760fccf69972552781e162138f06c76af.jpg[/img]
[/url]

The exciting news extends beyond INDIKA! [b]11 bit studios[/b] has been nominated for "[b]Studio of the Year[/b]". This nomination reflects our commitment to creating diverse, engaging experiences across all our titles, fueled by your support and feedback.

[h3]More Heartwarming News[/h3]

[url=http://goldenjoysticks.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/88e121022a1caf7d6adb996ee1a95631fd921040.jpg[/img]

[b]Your Voice Matters![/b]
These nominations are a direct result of your support and engagement. Now, we invite you to make your voice heard once again. If [b]INDIKA [/b]has moved you, challenged you, or sparked meaningful reflections, we'd be honored to have your [url=http://goldenjoysticks.com]vote[/url].

Every vote is a reminder of the impact that indie games can have. Thank you for being part of INDIKA's journey and for helping to showcase the power of innovative storytelling in games. 🖤

With deepest gratitude,
11 bit studios Team

notes.title: Indika review - A bizarre, beautiful, and unforgettable journey of a scorned nun
notes.content:
Indika is a game that definitely isn’t for everyone, as I very quickly learned while stepping into the titular protagonist’s shoes. The story first starts in a Russian Orthodox monastery, where Indika - a nun who is hearing a devilish voice - is clearly scorned by her peers. As the others tire of her, she is expelled from the monastery and ends up on a philosophical journey of self-discovery and self-loathing, questioning everything that she has known up until now.

Who determines what acts are more sinful than others? And are the punishments for our sins fair? If humans are sinful, why aren’t animals? Is a soul needed to experience love? If so, is God capable of truly loving anyone? These are just a small handful of the increasingly analytical questions that Indika raises on her short, puzzling adventure; an adventure that forces you to conjure up your innermost thoughts on morality and religion, while experiencing what is a stoic criticism of the Russian Orthodox Church and institutional religion.

Indika, put in the simplest of terms, is a relatively serious game (with some offbeat, comedic moments) that has you traveling from place to place as a troubled nun in an attempt to deliver a letter, but of course, other priorities come to light. There’s platforming, clever environmental puzzles to solve (that aren’t too troubling), and a thought-provoking story which is heavily influenced by directors Ari Aster (Midsommar, Beau is Afraid) and Yorgos Lanthimos (The Lobster, Poor Things), as well as writers Nikolai Gogol and Mikhail Bulgakov.

Read more

notes.title: INDIKA | Announcement Trailer and Statement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32989971/4d7f3fca414e6f5c241aa056ca8cd7518d5c02ee.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

INDIKA is a unique, narrative-driven adventure set in a parallel 19th-century Russia. Watch the Announcement Trailer and Statement from the developers to learn about the game and how Russia’s unjust invasion of Ukraine affected the working relationship between Odd Meter and 11 bit studios.

 [previewyoutube=D0EUUp46H54;full][/previewyoutube]
In INDIKA, players assume the role of the titular nun, Indika, embarking on a mind-bending journey to explore the duality of good and evil and the understanding that nothing is absolute. At its core, INDIKA is a third-person perspective adventure game, blending exploration with environmental puzzles and a touch of platforming. However, steeped in themes of sin, sorrow, and moral dilemmas, INDIKA transcends traditional gaming, resembling an art-house film that challenges societal norms rather than offering simple amusement.
